stages.name: Question
stages.zh: 夹住第二块骨牌，会阻断后面的倒牌吗？
stages.en: Does holding domino 2 stop the cascade?

stages.name: Observational skeleton
stages.zh: 观测只留下相邻骨牌的关系，虚线还没有方向。
stages.en: Observations give a chain; dashed edges have no direction yet.

stages.name: initial
stages.zh: 夹住第二块骨牌：观察倒牌传递是否被阻断。
stages.en: Hold domino 2: watch whether the cascade is blocked.

stages.name: Held readout
stages.zh: 采样：第二块被固定，第三至六块仍未倒下；松手后不再计入。
stages.en: Held readout: dominoes 2–6 remain upright. Release is outside this measurement.

stages.name: release_after_measurement
stages.zh: 读数已采集；松开并撤回不再用于本次图更新。
stages.en: Readout collected; release and retreat are not new graph evidence.

stages.name: Paired reset
stages.zh: 同一配对情境重新初始化，再直接推倒第二块。
stages.en: Reset the matched context; now push domino 2 instead.

stages.name: initial
stages.zh: 直接推倒第二块骨牌：观察哪些后续骨牌响应。
stages.en: Push domino 2: watch which downstream dominoes respond.

stages.name: Paired evidence
stages.zh: 配对读数显示不同响应；箭头仍由完整 64 对情境的证据决定。
stages.en: This pair illustrates the response; orientations use all 64 matched contexts.

stages.name: Direct evidence
stages.zh: 整批干预证据先确定 1→2 和 2→3。
stages.en: The intervention batch first orients 1→2 and 2→3.

stages.name: Graph-rule propagation
stages.zh: 再用图规则传播其余方向；绿色不是新增操作。
stages.en: Graph rules propagate the remaining directions; green means rule-derived.

stages.name: Result
stages.zh: 得到当前六节点链：干预证据与图规则各有来源。
stages.en: Current six-node chain: intervention evidence plus graph-rule propagation.

scope: Recorded graph-discovery illustration, not evidence for calibration benefits or complete causal identification.
presentation: Recomposited original robot frames; fixed cameras; English-only captions and labels; graph states from discovery logs. Static cards and explicit resets added. Timing follows original replay frame cadence, not a real-time physics claim.
